rawFindings.title: Incorrect filtering of 'this$' properties removed in v1 decoder readObject
rawFindings.explanation: The change removed the check that omitted properties with keys matching /^this\$\d+$/ in the readObject method of the v1 decoder. This causes properties like 'this$0' to be included in the decoded object, changing semantics and breaking compatibility with prior expectations and test cases.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the filtering to exclude keys matching /^this\$\d+$/ when reading object properties in v1 decoder readObject.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Decoding an object with a property named 'this$0' now includes it in the output object, whereas before it was excluded. This breaks backward compatibility and test expectations.
